freeze.reason: Trial 7 could not begin because Binance USD-M returned HTTP 451 from both available New York/Oracle collection environments. Trial 8 preserves the pre-result carry hypothesis while replacing the inaccessible venue with first-party U.S.-regulated public market data. Trial 7 remains an operational no-start, not a failed strategy result.
revisionLog: Before any Trial 8 observation, the Bitnomial funding URL was corrected from the generic /prod REST base assumption to the explicit first-party funding-rate request path documented by Bitnomial: /exchange/api/v1/funding-rates/. No economic parameter changed.

Before any Trial 8 observation, the Bitnomial product-spec request was changed from the undocumented ?active=true query to the documented /product/specs/ endpoint; the recorder itself filters product_status=active. No economic parameter changed.
Before any Trial 8 observation, an accidentally future-dated source-correction timestamp was replaced with the actual final pre-observation freeze time. This is provenance correction only.

hypothesis: A static BTC cash-and-carry position that buys Coinbase BTC-USD spot and shorts the Bitnomial Bitcoin USD Centi perpetual earns positive net funding carry over 180 days after conservative retail spot costs, Bitnomial exchange/clearing fees, basis movement, stale-price gates, and margin stress.

motivation.mechanism: positive Bitnomial perpetual funding transfers value from longs to shorts while equal BTC units hedge first-order BTC direction
motivation.publishedEvidenceRole: mechanism and hypothesis motivation only; no external historical return may score Trial 8
motivation.whyBitnomial: Bitnomial is a CFTC-registered designated contract market and publishes first-party public perpetual funding history containing interval timestamps, funding rate, mark price and price index.
motivation.whyCoinbaseSpot: Coinbase BTC-USD provides first-party public spot ticker data accessible in the user's normal U.S. environment.

perpetualShort.productName: Bitcoin US Dollar Centi Perpetual Futures

portfolio.contractCountRule: floor(targetNotionalUsd / (entryBitnomialPriceUsd * contractSizeBtc)), minimum 1 only when one contract notional is <= 25% of starting equity

executionModel.comment: Coinbase spot uses the published low-volume 60 bps taker tier plus a frozen 10 bps adverse-slippage allowance. Bitnomial exchange/clearing fee uses the published non-participant $0.10 per contract per side plus a frozen 10 bps price-slippage allowance. The stress case raises Coinbase spot all-in friction to 100 bps/order and Bitnomial slippage to 25 bps/order while retaining the fixed per-contract fee.

fundingAccounting.shortFundingPnlRule: For each first-party Bitnomial funding interval whose interval_end satisfies startBoundary < interval_end <= endBoundary, short funding PnL = btcQuantity * mark_price * funding_rate.

priceAccounting.coinbaseSpotEntry: first valid BTC-USD ticker at or after start boundary; buy fill is ask plus frozen adverse slippage
priceAccounting.coinbaseSpotExit: first valid BTC-USD ticker at or after evaluation boundary; sell fill is bid minus frozen adverse slippage
priceAccounting.bitnomialPerpetualEntry: first valid Bitnomial product last_price at or after start boundary with last_price_time no older than maximumBitnomialLastTradeAgeMinutes; short fill receives adverse lower price slippage
priceAccounting.bitnomialPerpetualExit: first valid Bitnomial product last_price at or after evaluation boundary with last_price_time no older than maximumBitnomialLastTradeAgeMinutes; buy-to-close fill pays adverse higher price slippage
priceAccounting.decomposition: netPnl = spotPricePnl + perpetualPricePnl + fundingPnl - explicitFees; report spot, perpetual, funding, basis and friction separately

sourceRules.bitnomialProductIdentityRule: The active product must identify the Bitcoin US Dollar Centi perpetual, have contract_size=0.01 BTC, and funding rows must match its product_id. Identity mismatch fails before economics.
sourceRules.bitnomialFundingCompletenessRule: Every regular 8-hour interval_end strictly after start and at or before end must be present; absent funding intervals fail the data gate rather than being synthesized or forward-filled.

marginStress.rule: Reserved perpetual collateral plus perpetual unrealized PnL plus accumulated funding must remain above the 15% research maintenance threshold under the observed path and each frozen adverse relative-basis shock. The 15% threshold matches Bitnomial Clearinghouse's currently published BTCUC maintenance margin, but it remains frozen as a Trial 8 research rule even if the venue later changes published margin.

comparators: Coinbase BTC-USD buy-and-hold using the identical BTC quantity and frozen Coinbase spot execution model
funding-only contribution before spot/perpetual basis and execution friction

requirements: all first-party identity, raw-hash, hourly-context, stale-price and funding-completeness gates pass
no observed or frozen-stress research margin breach
all first-party identity, raw-hash, hourly-context, stale-price and funding-completeness gates pass
annualized net return on total starting equity exceeds zero-return cash by at least 1 percentage point
at least two of three consecutive non-overlapping 60-day contribution windows have positive PnL
maximum drawdown on total starting equity is below 10%
frozen high-cost stress remains net positive
no observed or frozen-stress research margin breach
finalGate.afterPass: A pass permits only a separate proposal to replace the paper baseline. It never authorizes real-money trading.

antiLeakage.failureRule: After the first Trial 8 candidate observation, any change to venues, direction, BTC quantity rule, costs, collateral, window, funding accounting, stale-price rule, data substitution or stress rules requires a new trial number.
